info.title: Tourbillon API
info.description: Read-only. Open, no keys, rate-limited per IP (429 when over). Amounts in USDC are decimal strings with 6 decimals; strikes, units and marks are decimal strings. Values from /v1/chains are indicative; /v1/quote/buy gives the exact cost at the current block.

get.summary: Opens and pauses, the pool's NAV and coverage, mark and vol freshness per market, the last receipt root

200.description: { chainId, block, blockTime, opens: { buysPaused, drawdownPaused, depositsPaused }, pool: { nav, navPerShare, lastSettlement, available, stressedLiability, covered }, markets: [{ market, markFresh, volFresh, opensPaused }], receipts: { lastEpoch } }

get.summary: Every market: listing, spread, strike step, mark, vol, caps and their use, pauses

200.description: { markets: [{ market, listed, spreadBps, strikeStep, mark, volBps, opensPaused, caps: { notional, notionalUsed, directional, directionalUsed } }] }

get.summary: Indicative call and put values per unit around the mark, for each tempo, at the board's vol

200.description: { market, mark, volBps, indicative: true, chains: [{ tempo, rows: [{ strike, call, put }] }] }

get.summary: The exact cost (premium plus fee) of a buy at the current block, from the cheapest of the pool and the maker quotes

200.description: { market, quoted: true, cost, source: pool | maker | offer, makerQuotesConsidered } or { quoted: false, reason }

get.summary: An owner's positions, held directly or in the AgentRouter sub-account, with units at the current norm

200.description: { owner, positions: [{ id, held, market, legs, movement, raw, units, unitsDecimal }] }

get.summary: The Merkle proof of a receipt (a trade, a vol final or a NAV snapshot), checkable with ReceiptRoots.verify

200.description: { epoch, kind, encoded, leaf, proof, root, posted }
